$comment: Settings for the stocks advisory's Azure resources (infra/stocks/main.bicep), read by tools/azure/provision-stocks.ps1. No secrets here: the EODHD key goes to the vault from the script's prompt or a file. The image is pulled from the CIX registry of registryEnvironment (infra/environments/<name>.json). schedule is a cron expression in UTC; it must start after stocks/config/stocks.json's dataReadyUtc. The Claude analyst (ADR-0027) runs at analystSchedule, after the nightly run, with analystModel and Claude Code claudeCodeVersion (an exact x.y.z, so a new release changes nothing until you change it; latest is allowed and warns); claudeTokenExpires (YYYY-MM-DD) makes it warn before your Claude token expires, and is taken from registryEnvironment's agents.claudeTokenExpires when empty.
